answer.reason: Genesis 34 tells what happened to Dinah: she was defiled by Shechem and was later taken out of his house after her brothers slew the city's males.

clauses.english: was defiled by Shechem the son of Hamor
clauses.quote: he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

clauses.english: was taken out of Shechem's house after her brothers slew the males of the city
clauses.quote: took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.

doubts: GEN 30:21 and GEN 46:15 only give her birth and place her in a list, so they were not used.
